changes: Latest initialization owns session restore and observer registration
Auth revision plus starting session reference reject obsolete restore/error
Cleanup invalidates pending startup and queued callbacks
Logout and successful delete use shared observer cleanup
Stale startup after newer login still registers current SDK observer when its initialization is active
additional_case: Same-account reauthentication may replace session without advancing auth revision; captured-session comparison covers it
limitations: Controlled async store tests, not actual flaky-network native login
Does not cancel an SDK-internal session read or bound the whole initialization pipeline
Native APK/iOS artifact predates this source change; rebuild/runtime check still needed
Wear-counter reconciliation and other full-readiness gates remain open
